prompt: For a trip, Dana packs 5 shirts, 4 pairs of pants, and 3 dresses. Each day she wears either one shirt together with one pair of pants, or one dress by itself. How many different outfits can she wear?
When all of the whole numbers from 1 through 250 are written out, how many times is the digit 3 written?

In a game, a player rolls a fair six-sided number cube once. A roll of 6 wins $14, a roll of 4 or 5 wins $4, and a roll of 1, 2, or 3 loses $5. If a player plays this game 30 times, what is the expected total of the player's winnings minus losses, in dollars?

Using only nickels (5 cents), dimes (10 cents), and quarters (25 cents), in how many different ways can exactly 60 cents be made? (Two ways are different if they use a different number of at least one kind of coin.)

A moving walkway 120 meters long carries people at 1.5 meters per second. Kim walks at 2.5 meters per second relative to the walkway. She walks from one end to the other in the direction the walkway moves, then immediately turns around and walks back to her starting point against the walkway's motion. How many seconds does the round trip take?

A restaurant bill was $40 for food and $10 for drinks. Food prices then rose by 15 percent while drink prices stayed the same. For the same order, by what percent did the total bill increase? (Round to the nearest tenth of a percent.)
The mean of seven numbers is 11. The mean of the first four numbers is 9, and the mean of the last four numbers is 15. What is the sum of the first three numbers?

Three roads connect town A to town B, and four roads connect town B to town C. In addition, two direct roads connect town A to town C without passing through B. Ana travels from A to C and then returns from C to A. If she never travels on the same road twice, how many different round trips are possible?
How many three-digit whole numbers have digits whose sum is 8?
The product 1 × 2 × 3 × ... × 75 of all the whole numbers from 1 through 75 is written out in full. How many zeros are at the end of this number?
What is the least positive whole number that has exactly 10 positive factors?
The decimal 0.2363636... continues forever, with the block of digits 36 repeating after the 2. Which fraction is equal to this decimal?
What is the mean absolute deviation of the data set 2, 6, 7, 9, 21? (The mean absolute deviation is the average distance of the values from their mean.)

A drawer holds 1 red sock, 2 green socks, 7 blue socks, and 9 black socks. Socks are taken out one at a time without looking. What is the least number of socks that must be taken out to be certain that at least 4 of the socks taken out are the same color?
The functions f and g are defined by f(x) = 3x - 4 and g(x) = x^2 + 2. What is the value of f(g(3))?
Line l passes through the point (12, 6) and is perpendicular to the line 3x - 2y = 10. What is the y-intercept of line l?

A cyclist leaves a town riding at a steady 24 kilometers per hour. Thirty minutes later, a car leaves the same town along the same road in the same direction, traveling at a steady 72 kilometers per hour. How many minutes after the car leaves does it catch up with the cyclist?
In the coordinate plane, point P lies on the x-axis and is the same distance from A(-1, 5) as it is from B(4, 10). What is the x-coordinate of P?
If 3/(x - 2) = 5/(x + 4), what is the value of x?
The sequence 8, -5, 3, 8, -5, 3, ... repeats the three numbers 8, -5, and 3 in that order forever. What is the sum of the first 40 terms of the sequence?

A ball is dropped from a height of 256 centimeters. Each time it hits the ground, it bounces straight back up to 3/4 of the height from which it last fell. What is the total distance, in centimeters, the ball has traveled at the moment it hits the ground for the fourth time?
A circle has a radius of 7 centimeters. A square has a perimeter equal to the circumference of the circle. Using 22/7 for pi, what is the area of the square, in square centimeters?
In the coordinate plane, the lines y = x + 2 and y = -2x + 14 intersect at point P. What is the area of the triangle formed by these two lines and the x-axis?
The first term of an arithmetic sequence is 2. The eighth term is 6 more than three times the third term. What is the twelfth term of the sequence?
Two sides of a triangle measure 5 centimeters and 12 centimeters. The length of the third side is a whole number of centimeters. How many different lengths are possible for the third side?
What is the value of x that satisfies the equation sqrt(x + 36) = x - 6 ?
If 2^a = 5, what is the value of 2^(a + 3)?

A store spent $360 on ribbon, all at the same price per meter. If the price had been $5 more per meter, the same $360 would have bought 6 fewer meters. What was the price of the ribbon, in dollars per meter?
